name: DDColor colourisation model
description: DDColor-T, the default model for the Colourisation pass: vivid, natural colour for black-and-white footage, predicted per frame and steadied over neighbouring frames. Converted to ONNX from the project's own published weights.
credit: Xiaoyang Kang, Tao Yang, Wenqi Ouyang, Peiran Ren, Lingzhi Li and Xuansong Xie
